title: picard_residue_source_model_homology
statement:
theorem picard_residue_source_model_homology
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v}, HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (w : W)
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) :
    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
      ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) :=
      SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
    letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
    let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
    letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
    let C := ((F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K
    Nonempty (derivedFiberCohomology W E 1 w ≃ₗ[W.residueField w] C.homology 1)

proof.text: Evaluate the finite free retractions in the strictly perfect hypothesis. freeSectionsLinearEquiv identifies the ambient section modules with finite free modules. Retract.projective gives projectivity, hence flatness, of each section term. Evaluation preserves zero objects and the upper support bound. The categorical bounded-above flat K-flat criterion kFlat_of_isStrictlyLE_of_flat therefore makes the actual terminal section complex K-flat.

Use affine_perfect_module_model to put K in the essential image of affinePerfectSheafification. Construct the canonical chart/slice equivalence as picardChartEquivalence with explicit forward and inverse equations. Compose tilde.adjunction with its equivalence adjunction. Since the left functor is fully faithful, its counit is invertible on every term of K. The proved private overChartSectionsIso from AffineFreeTerminalSectionsReconstruction identifies the right adjoint with terminal evaluation. Map the counit and this natural isomorphism to complexes, explicitly using mapHomologicalComplexCompIso rather than unfolding composed equivalences. This gives the local proved picardTerminalSectionsReconstruction.

Compose Q of the reconstruction with the supplied hE. Apply affine_kFlat_residuePullback_model to the actual section complex and its K-flat proof. Apply affine_residue_scalar_transport to the same affine chart point. Its natural isomorphism, lifted to complexes, rewrites the prime residue-field extension and scalar restriction as extension along W.evaluation U w hwU.

The moduleSpecGammaFunctor over a field is an equivalence by isEquivalence_moduleSpecGammaFunctor, hence preserves homology. Apply degree-one derived homology to the derived model isomorphism and use homologyFunctorFactors. Apply mapHomologyIso to commute field-spectrum sections and complex homology. The tilde.toTildeGammaNatIso unit, mapped to complexes and degree-one homology, returns the scalar-extended section complex. Compose the three module-category isomorphisms and take toLinearEquiv.
